text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Triggered: `hosted-api p99 latency` in `us-east` > 2.5s for 10m (current 6.9s). Errors 5xx up to 1.8%.

Aisha Rahman: seeing TTFT blow up too (streaming). Anyone on runtime/scheduler around?

Alex Martinez: here. Looking at `runtime-kv` graphs now. KV eviction rate is *insane* since ~09:30 UTC.

Dev Patel: correlates w/ rollout of `runtime-1.18.3` canary? looks like jumped right when canary hit 25%.

Mina Haddad: customers already pinging in #support, mostly ‘stream stalls’ + occasional 503.

Aisha Rahman: declare Sev1? hosted prod impacted. incident id: INC-2025-02-14-CACHETHRASHER

incident-bot: Incident declared: INC-2025-02-14-CACHETHRASHER Severity: Sev1 Commander: Aisha Rahman

Alex Martinez: hypothesis: new KV cache admission policy is thrashing under long prompts. eviction loop -> extra recompute -> TTFT/p99 + 5xx from OOM retries.

Dev Patel: quick mitigation option: flip flag `kv_cache.admission=legacy` (was `dynamic_v2`). Should be safe.

Aisha Rahman: do it for us-east hosted first. also stop canary expansion.

deploy-bot: (in thread) Rollout paused: `runtime-1.18.3` at 25% (hosted us-east).

Dev Patel: pushing config override now.

Mina Haddad: status page? at least internal comms for CS.

Aisha Rahman: yes, draft status update: “elevated latency + intermittent errors on streaming API in us-east”. no root cause yet.

Dev Patel: config applied. eviction rate dropping. p99 coming down (still high but improving).

Alex Martinez: confirming: TTFT improved from ~4-6s to ~1.2s. errors back <0.2%.

Aisha Rahman: keep monitoring. Alex can you start diffing 1.18.2 vs 1.18.3 in `kv/admission`? need PR revert or fix today.

Alex Martinez: on it. suspect edge case when `prefill_tokens > 4096` + mixed batch. will write up in INT ticket.
